Rolling Stone — October 5, 2012

New and Hot Video: Antibalas Jam to 'Dirty Money' at Daptone Studios Premiere

Rolling Stone

Back in August, the Brooklyn-based Afrobeat outfit Antibalas released their eponymous fifth album on Daptone Records. Now you can check out this exclusive clip of the group performing the tasty, funk-tastic cut "Dirty Money" on the back patio of Daptone's House of Soul Studios in Bushwick, Brooklyn.

Directed by Philip Di Fiore, the video includes interviews with singer Duke Amayo and group founder Martin Perna, and it is the first in the new Live From the House of Soul series. If you're in the mood for more grooving, be sure to look into Antibalas' upcoming tour dates here.

Originally published by Rolling Stone, October 5, 2012. Archived via the Wayback Machine.
